name: commons-grok-cloud
description: Run bidirectional Commons work between GPT cloud sessions and grok.com with Slack and exact receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Give GPT and Grok one durable two-way Commons lane.
interface.longDescription: Installs the shared Commons MCP plus the cloud-browser executor and Grok client bundle. GPT can execute work through the account's grok.com session, while Grok can call the same public Commons MCP directly or through a lossless forward envelope, returning Slack and Commons receipts with the real conversation URL, prompt, result, and inspected SHA.
defaultPrompt: Run this task through grok.com and land the receipt.
Take the next unclaimed Grok task from Commons.
Let Grok use Commons and return a durable result.
Show the live Commons model-route catalog.
